newsitem.title: UK: Vickers rejects talk of Rolls sale to BMW.
newsitem.headline: Vickers rejects talk of Rolls sale to BMW.

text.p: Britain's Vickers Group Plc on Monday dismissed a press report that said Germany's BMW might be once again considering taking a stake in its Rolls-Royce luxury car unit.
A spokeswoman for Vickers said the report was just old speculation that the company had rejected "time and time again."

"We have no intention of getting rid of Rolls-Royce, partially or wholly. We have spent a lot of money on new models, the business is doing well and there are exciting times ahead," the spokeswoman said.
A BMW spokesman also rejected the report. "There is nothing to it," a BMW spokesman told Reuters.
Continuing a rebound from their 28-month low of 168p set July 15, Vickers shares were up 3p at 180 by 1410 GMT in moderate volume of just over one million shares.
